stdout:
A reply for another subscription, not chargeable, never drops the member
  ok    the member is still to be tried again
  ok    and still counted for the creator
  ok    nothing is written to Stripe

A reply with no id, not chargeable, never drops the member
  ok    the member is still to be tried again
  ok    and still counted for the creator
  ok    nothing is written to Stripe

A reply for another subscription, already held, never drops the member
  ok    the member is still to be tried again
  ok    and still counted for the creator
  ok    nothing is written to Stripe

A reply for another subscription, chargeable, never holds that other one
  ok    nothing is written to Stripe for another subscription
  ok    no invoice of another subscription is read
  ok    the other subscription is never written down as a member
  ok    the member is still to be tried again

A reply that is null, not an object, never drops the member
  ok    the member is still to be tried again
  ok    nothing is written to Stripe and no invoice is read

A reply that is a string, not an object, never drops the member
  ok    the member is still to be tried again
  ok    nothing is written to Stripe and no invoice is read

A reply that is a number, not an object, never drops the member
  ok    the member is still to be tried again
  ok    nothing is written to Stripe and no invoice is read

The member's own reply still decides
  ok    a member whose own subscription ended leaves the line
  ok    a member whose own subscription is chargeable is held

An open invoice listed for the member that names another subscription is never voided
  ok    another subscription's invoice is not voided
  ok    a list with a row of another subscription: the member is not counted held, it is tried again

An open invoice listed with no subscription, or another customer's, is never voided
  ok    an open invoice with no subscription is not voided
  ok    an open invoice with no subscription: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    an open invoice with another customer is not voided
  ok    an open invoice with another customer: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    an open invoice with no customer is not voided
  ok    an open invoice with no customer: the member is not counted held, it is tried again

A draft listed for the member that is another subscription's is never kept as a draft
  ok    another subscription's draft is not written to
  ok    nor written down to be let go on a release
  ok    a draft list with a row of another subscription: the member is not counted held, it is tried again

A paid invoice listed for the member that is another subscription's, or names none, is never its last payment
  ok    with another subscription's on top, no payment is written down for the member
  ok    a paid list with another subscription's on top: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    with one with no subscription on top, no payment is written down for the member
  ok    a paid list with one with no subscription on top: the member is not counted held, it is tried again

The member's own invoices are still acted on, where either API version names the subscription
  ok    (on the invoice) its open invoice is voided
  ok    (on the invoice) its draft is kept as a draft
  ok    (on the invoice) its last payment is written down
  ok    (on the invoice) it is held and leaves the line
  ok    (under its parent) its open invoice is voided
  ok    (under its parent) its draft is kept as a draft
  ok    (under its parent) its last payment is written down
  ok    (under its parent) it is held and leaves the line

An invoice list answered with something that is not a list never counts the member held
  ok    the open invoices answered with null: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the open invoices answered with a string: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the open invoices answered with a number: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the open invoices answered with an object with no data: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the draft invoices answered with null: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the draft invoices answered with a string: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the draft invoices answered with a number: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the draft invoices answered with an object with no data: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the paid invoices answered with null: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the paid invoices answered with a string: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the paid invoices answered with a number: the member is not counted held, it is tried again
  ok    the paid invoices answered with an object with no data: the member is not counted held, it is tried again

The store's search answered with something that is not a list is never its last page
  ok    a search answered with null: the hold is not done, and nothing is written
  ok    a search answered with a string: the hold is not done, and nothing is written
  ok    a search answered with a number: the hold is not done, and nothing is written
  ok    a search answered with an object with no data: the hold is not done, and nothing is written

A search page that does not say exactly whether there is more is never the last one
  ok    a search page with no has_more: the hold is not done
  ok    a search page with has_more true and no next_page: the hold is not done
  ok    a search page with has_more as a string: the hold is not done

A search row that is not an object is never skipped as another store's
  ok    a search row that is null: the hold is not done
  ok    a search row that is a string: the hold is not done
  ok    a search row that is a number: the hold is not done

A subscription the store's search found that is not of the handle searched is never held
  ok    a subscription of another handle is never written to
  ok    nor its invoices read
  ok    nor written down as a member
  ok    the store's own member is held
